description: This file defines the 'EncounterVisitHandler' interface in the OpenMRS project. It specifies methods for handling logic related to associating encounters with visits, including display names for handlers and the decision-making process for assigning encounters to visits.

classes.name: EncounterVisitHandler
classes.description: Interface for handlers that determine how encounters are associated with visits. It includes methods for retrieving display names and handling the logic before encounter creation.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the handler, suitable for display. One version accepts no parameters, while the other accepts a Locale to localize the name.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Contains the core logic for deciding whether an encounter should be assigned to an existing visit or a new visit. It calls Encounter#setVisit(Visit) accordingly.
